## Autonomous Mode

> The back office a small firm would have, set up for one independent consultant (practices of 1-10 people), installed by Ato Sam. It knows the consultant's clients, offers, priorities and voice, and runs the work around the client work: a morning brief from inbox and calendar, follow-ups, a prospect pipeline, proposals and client updates, and posts from voice notes. Guardrails keep everything in draft until the consultant approves, and a weekly review keeps it current. Built on Claude (Anthropic).

## Offer
- First command (a morning brief from inbox and calendar) within 48 hours; fully set up in 14 days; 60 days of support.
- Six parts: Practice Brain, three commands, Voice Lock, Guardrails (drafts only), Weekly Review, Handover Kit. Includes Voice Note to Post.
- Guarantee 1 (risk of starting): full refund of everything paid if the first command isn't running on the client's own inbox and calendar by day 7. Client's part: attend the intake call and give access on day 1.
- Guarantee 2: if by day 30 it isn't saving at least three hours a week against a baseline of their recurring work written down on the intake call, work continues at no charge until it does.
- Price: $7,500 USD paid in full, or two payments of $4,000 (day 1 and day 14). The first 5 installs are free, in full, in exchange for a case study (two 30-minute calls); after that, $7,500. Optional care $1,500/month after day 74. Claude subscription billed separately by Anthropic.
